services.name: Adult cleaning
services.summary: A hygienist removes plaque and tartar, polishes your teeth and shows you what to focus on at home.

services.name: Child cleaning
services.summary: A gentle clean and polish for children, with tips for brushing and a check on growing teeth.

services.name: Complete upper denture
services.summary: A full removable set of upper teeth, made to fit your mouth over a few fittings.

services.name: Composite filling, one surface
services.summary: A tooth-coloured filling that repairs a small cavity on one side of a tooth, usually in one visit.

services.name: Comprehensive oral exam
services.summary: A full check of your teeth, gums and bite, with X-rays if needed, and a plan for anything we find.

services.name: Comprehensive orthodontics (clear aligners)
services.summary: Straightening your teeth with clear, removable aligners, worn about 22 hours a day.

services.name: Emergency palliative treatment
services.summary: Quick relief for dental pain or injury. Call us and we will see you as soon as we can.

services.name: Implant placement
services.summary: Placing a titanium post to replace a missing tooth root, planned with a 3D scan first.

services.name: Root canal, molar
services.summary: Treats infection inside a back tooth and seals it, so you can keep the tooth instead of losing it.

services.name: Simple extraction
services.summary: Removing a tooth that can be lifted out simply, with numbing so you feel pressure, not pain.

services.name: Video consultation
services.summary: Talk to a dentist on video from home: questions, a quick look at a concern, or what to book next.

services.name: Whitening
services.summary: Brightening the colour of your teeth safely in the clinic, after a quick check that it suits you.
